source_metadata.exact_title: New Delhi Metallo-β-Lactamase-1 in Carbapenem-Resistant Salmonella Strain, China
source_metadata.source_type: Letter to the Editor; single-patient case report with microbiologic and plasmid characterization

atoms.canonical_statement: The authors report a community-acquired NDM-1-bearing Salmonella strain isolated from a child with acute diarrhea.

source_anchor.verbatim_excerpt: We report the isolation of 1 community-acquired NDM-1–bearing Salmonella strain isolated from a child with acute diarrhea.

atoms.canonical_statement: The case patient was an 11-month-old girl from Zhejiang Province, China, with fever, cough, and subsequent bloody-mucoid diarrhea; the family reported no international travel during the prior year and she had no contact with hospitalized patients.

source_anchor.verbatim_excerpt: The Salmonella strain was isolated from the feces of an 11-month-old girl at Lishui Central Hospital, Zhejiang Province, China, on July 25, 2012.

population.label: 11-month-old girl with acute diarrhea and fever

atoms.canonical_statement: Before admission, the patient received parenteral cefoxitin for 3 days and parenteral piperacillin/tazobactam for 1 day, but fever persisted.

source_anchor.verbatim_excerpt: The condition was treated with parenteral cefoxitin for 3 days and parenteral piperacillin/tazobactam for 1 day, but fever persisted.

atoms.canonical_statement: A fecal isolate obtained at admission was identified as Salmonella enterica subsp. enterica serovar Stanley by serotyping.

source_anchor.verbatim_excerpt: A Salmonella sp. was isolated from feces obtained at admission and identified as S. enterica subsp. enterica serovar Stanley by serotyping by the local Centers for Disease Control and Prevention.

atoms.canonical_statement: After a diagnosis of bacterial enteritis, the patient received intravenous azithromycin and latamoxef.

source_anchor.verbatim_excerpt: The patient was then given a diagnosis of bacterial enteritis and received intravenous azithromycin and latamoxef.

atoms.canonical_statement: Fever and diarrhea resolved over the next 3 days after intravenous azithromycin and latamoxef were started.

source_anchor.verbatim_excerpt: Fever and diarrhea resolved over the next 3 days.

quantitative_result.original_result_text: Fever and diarrhea resolved over the next 3 days.

atoms.canonical_statement: On hospital day 5, fecal culture was negative for Salmonella spp., and the patient was discharged.

source_anchor.verbatim_excerpt: On the fifth day of hospitalization, a fecal culture was negative for Salmonella spp. and the patient was discharged.

atoms.canonical_statement: At 3-month follow-up, Salmonella spp. and other carbapenem-resistant bacteria were not isolated from fecal samples from the patient, her grandmother, or her brother.

source_anchor.verbatim_excerpt: At a follow-up visit 3 months later, Salmonella spp. or other carbapenem-resistant bacteria were not isolated from feces samples from the patient or her grandmother and brother, who lived with her.

atoms.canonical_statement: Antimicrobial MICs were determined by agar dilution and interpreted using revised Clinical and Laboratory Standards Institute breakpoints.

source_anchor.verbatim_excerpt: MICs of antimicrobial drugs were determined by agar dilution and interpreted by using revised Clinical and Laboratory Standards Institute breakpoints (5).

atoms.canonical_statement: The Salmonella Stanley isolate was resistant to all tested beta-lactam agents, including cephalosporins and carbapenems, and was reported susceptible to chloramphenicol, ciprofloxacin, tetracycline, and fosfomycin; its azithromycin MIC was 4 µg/mL.

source_anchor.verbatim_excerpt: The Salmonella Stanley strain was resistant to all β-lactam antimicrobial drugs tested, including cephalosporins and carbapenems, but susceptible to chloramphenicol, ciprofloxacin, tetracycline, and fosfomycin, and had azithromycin MICs of 4 µg/mL (Table).

population.label: Salmonella Stanley isolate from case patient

atoms.canonical_statement: The modified Hodge test for the Salmonella Stanley isolate was weakly positive.

source_anchor.verbatim_excerpt: A modified Hodge test result for Salmonella strain Stanley was weakly positive.

atoms.canonical_statement: Metallo-beta-lactamase production was detected by an imipenem-EDTA double-disk synergy test.

source_anchor.verbatim_excerpt: Production of metallo-β-lactamase was detected by using an imipenem-EDTA double-disk synergy test.

atoms.canonical_statement: PCR was used to test carbapenemase-encoding genes including blaKPC-2, blaVIM, blaIMP, blaSPM-1, blaGIM-1, and blaSIM-1, with blaNDM-1 assayed using specified primers.

source_anchor.verbatim_excerpt: Carbapenamase-encoding genes, including blaKPC-2, blaVIM, blaIMP, blaSPM-1, blaGIM-1, and blaSIM-1, were detected by using PCR as described (2). Only the blaNDM-1 gene was detected.

atoms.canonical_statement: Only blaNDM-1 was detected in the tested carbapenemase gene panel.

source_anchor.verbatim_excerpt: Only the blaNDM-1 gene was detected.

atoms.canonical_statement: The blaNDM-1 PCR product sequence was consistent with NDM-1 sequence GenBank accession FN396876.

source_anchor.verbatim_excerpt: The PCR product sequence was consistent with that of NDM-1 (GenBank accession no. FN396876).

atoms.canonical_statement: Conjugation experiments tested transfer of carbapenem resistance from Salmonella Stanley to rifampin-resistant Escherichia coli C600 and Klebsiella pneumoniae 13883 after 15 minutes of exposure.

source_anchor.verbatim_excerpt: Conjugation experiments were conducted as described (6). Carbapenem resistance could be transferred from Salmonella strain Stanley to E. coli C600 Rifᵣ and K. pneumoniae 13883 Rifᵣ ... after exposure for 15 min.

atoms.canonical_statement: Transfer to Escherichia coli C600 occurred at approximately 1 transconjugant per 1.0 × 10^4 bacterial cells after 15 minutes.

source_anchor.verbatim_excerpt: Carbapenem resistance could be transferred from Salmonella strain Stanley to E. coli C600 Rifᵣ ... at frequencies of 1 transconjugant per ≈1.0 × 10^4 ... bacterial cells, respectively, after exposure for 15 min.

population.label: Escherichia coli C600 Rif-resistant recipient cells

concept.text: formation of carbapenem-resistant E. coli transconjugants

atoms.canonical_statement: Transfer to Klebsiella pneumoniae 13883 occurred at approximately 1 transconjugant per 4.0 × 10^7 bacterial cells after 15 minutes.

source_anchor.verbatim_excerpt: Carbapenem resistance could be transferred from Salmonella strain Stanley to ... K. pneumoniae 13883 Rifᵣ at frequencies of 1 transconjugant per ≈1.0 × 10^4 and 4.0 × 10^7 bacterial cells, respectively, after exposure for 15 min.

concept.text: formation of carbapenem-resistant K. pneumoniae transconjugants

atoms.canonical_statement: Plasmid DNA was extracted, plasmid profiles were compared by electrophoresis, and plasmid incompatibility group was assessed by PCR-based replicon typing.

source_anchor.verbatim_excerpt: Plasmid DNA was extracted by using a Plasmid Midi Kit ... Electrophoresis showed that donor and transconjugant strains had the same plasmid profile ... A PCR-based method for plasmid replicon typing (7) indicated that the plasmid belonged to incompatibility group IncA/C.

atoms.canonical_statement: The donor and transconjugant strains had the same plasmid profile, and each contained an approximately 140-kb plasmid.

source_anchor.verbatim_excerpt: Electrophoresis showed that donor and transconjugant strains had the same plasmid profile; both contained an ≈140-kb plasmid.

atoms.canonical_statement: PCR-based replicon typing classified the approximately 140-kb plasmid as incompatibility group IncA/C.

source_anchor.verbatim_excerpt: A PCR-based method for plasmid replicon typing (7) indicated that the plasmid belonged to incompatibility group IncA/C.

atoms.canonical_statement: For blaNDM-1 stability testing, 20 colonies were randomly selected each day during days 2 through 15 from Salmonella Stanley, E. coli transconjugants, and K. pneumoniae transconjugants.

source_anchor.verbatim_excerpt: Experiments of blaNDM-1 stability in Salmonella spp., E. coli transconjugants, and K. pneumoniae transconjugants were conducted ... Twenty colonies were randomly selected every day during days 2–15.

atoms.canonical_statement: During the stability experiment, 2 Salmonella Stanley colonies lost carbapenem resistance; these were recovered on passage days 2 and 9 and lacked plasmids containing blaNDM-1.

source_anchor.verbatim_excerpt: Only 2 colonies of the Salmonella Stanley strain lost carbapenem resistance; these colonies were collected on the second and ninth days of passage, respectively. Plasmids containing blaNDM-1 were not present in these 2 colonies.

population.label: Salmonella Stanley colonies sampled during days 2-15

quantitative_result.effect_measure: count of colonies losing carbapenem resistance
quantitative_result.original_result_text: Only 2 colonies of the Salmonella Stanley strain lost carbapenem resistance.

atoms.canonical_statement: No E. coli or K. pneumoniae transconjugants lost carbapenem resistance during 14 days of passage.

source_anchor.verbatim_excerpt: No transconjugants lost carbapenem resistance during 14 days of passage.

population.label: E. coli and K. pneumoniae transconjugants

quantitative_result.effect_measure: count of transconjugants losing carbapenem resistance
quantitative_result.original_result_text: No transconjugants lost carbapenem resistance during 14 days of passage.

atoms.canonical_statement: The authors concluded that the report indicates ongoing spread of NDM-1-bearing Salmonella strains.

source_anchor.verbatim_excerpt: This report indicates ongoing spread of NDM-1–bearing Salmonella strains.

atoms.canonical_statement: The authors suggested that the conjugation frequency and stability of the IncA/C plasmid carrying NDM-1 in Salmonella could increase dissemination of bacterial drug resistance.

source_anchor.verbatim_excerpt: If one considers the high conjugation frequency and stability of the IncA/C plasmid containing NDM-1 in Salmonella spp., one would conclude that it might increase spread of bacterial drug resistance.

atoms.canonical_statement: The authors stated that prompt recognition of carbapenem-resistant Salmonella and appropriate infection-control measures are essential to avoid spread.

source_anchor.verbatim_excerpt: Prompt recognition of carbapenem-resistant Salmonella spp. and initiation of appropriate infection control measures are essential to avoid spread of these organisms.

atoms.canonical_statement: For Piperacillin/tazobactam, the reported MICs (µg/mL) were >128/4 for Salmonella Stanley, 2/4 for E. coli C600, 128/4 for the E. coli C600 transconjugant, 1/4 for K. pneumoniae 13883, and 128/4 for the K. pneumoniae 13883 transconjugant.
